parsed.narrative: Samuel Pepys rises and puts on his new stuff suit with close knees, which his wife says becomes him most nobly. He spends the day at the office, then at noon dons his first all-lace band and goes to Kate Joyce's for dinner with his mother, wife, and many friends, receiving good usage. He then buys two more lace bands at the Old Exchange with his wife and Mercer, visits Deptford and Woolwich to arrange bringing his wife down for a month or two, and returns late to write letters at the office before supper and bed. Meanwhile, the town grows very sickly with the plague, deaths rising from 43 to 112 in one week, and people grow afraid.
